session_title: Undergraduate Workshop for Women & Minorities - hosted by Women in Chemical Engineering
abstract: Undergraduates! Join us for this workshop that will help answer your questions on career choices. Students thinking about graduate school, come and learn what the application process entails, how to select a school and an advisor, what fellowships to apply for, etc. For students interested in industrial opportunities, learn how to land a dream job. For those still deciding, come and learn about what careers in academia, industry, and government labs entail.
